verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's first-party Platforms solution covers all three parts of the story for marketplaces and Payfacs: onboarding sub-entities, splitting funds between the platform and sub-entities, and paying out to sub-entities in their local currency and preferred method. A /transfers endpoint is also listed among the idempotent APIs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the onboarding/KYC API flow, split-configuration mechanics and payout scheduling, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: The Platforms solution enables marketplaces, payment facilitators (Payfacs), and other platform-based businesses to onboard sub-entities and process payments on their behalf.
Split funds between your platform and sub-entities according to your business model.
Make payouts to your sub-entities in their local currency and preferred payment method.
